title: CalSPR V2.4: Information-source and risk boundaries for SPR calibration transfer
description: Computational reproducibility materials for the CalSPR V2.4 study of information sources and calibration-transfer risk in surface plasmon resonance. Software version 2.4.1 includes planar optical and Poisson count models, nuisance-projected Fisher information, deterministic pseudo-true fitting, predeclared simulation configurations, complete inversion modules, material optical-constant source tables, frozen Monte Carlo outputs, deterministic tests, figure source data, and plotting/revision scripts. The source repository is https://github.com/mzw423502/calspr-calibration-transfer. The original CalSPR code is released under MIT; copied plotting helpers retain Apache-2.0, and the three refractiveindex.info material tables retain their original CC0 notices. The archive preserves the study's numerical results; full Monte Carlo was not rerun during release packaging. These are computational-model results, not measurements from a manufactured SPR instrument.
